

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
arch_data <- read.table(
  "/Users/karenzhu/Desktop/Projects/MAIN_structure_project/work/SP001_050/SP001/arch_combined_chainsaw.txt", 
  header = TRUE, 
  sep = "\t") 

phage_data <- read.table(
  "/Users/karenzhu/Desktop/Projects/MAIN_structure_project/work/SP001_050/SP001/phage_combined_chainsaw.txt", 
  header = TRUE, 
  sep = "\t") 


```

```{r}
euk_data <- read.delim(
  "/Users/karenzhu/Desktop/Projects/MAIN_structure_project/work/SP001_050/SP001/euk_combined_chainsaw.txt", 
  header = TRUE) 
```


```{r}
h <- hist(arch_data$confidence, plot = FALSE, breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1))

# Convert counts to percentages (density = percentage of total)
h$density <- h$counts / sum(h$counts) * 100

# Plot the histogram with percentages on the y-axis
plot(h, freq = FALSE, main = "Archaeal Viral Domains", 
     xlim=c(0.4, 1),
     xlab = "Confidence", ylab = "Relative Frequency", col = "lightblue", border = "black")


```
